content: Sarai e-sui-Abramʼga geg mimmi bake gusad. Saraiʼde e-mai-Egiptoʼgined nikad, Agarʼye nugad.

Geb Sarai, Abramʼga sogded: —Bab-Jehová geg goe-bake an-imaksad. Degisoggu, an bese wilesakwaa egissundo, bunagwa an-maiga-gudiidse be gole. Abakale a-omebali, an mimmi nikualile. Abram Sarai-ega-soged nabir itosad.
Deunni, Abram birgambegus (10) Canaán-yargi maid. Geb a-ibagangine, Sarai bunagwa-Egiptoʼgined-Agarʼye-nugad, Abramʼga urmaksad, ese golegar.
Abram Agarʼse-gochagu, Agar gurgin-nika gunonikid. Agar gurgin-nikagudi-itoargu, e-dummad-Sarai-ibgwensur dakded.

Geb degine, Sarai Abramʼga sogded: —¡Be-ular, emide, Agar ibgwensur an-dakalid! An-sunnad an bega Agar-urmaksad, ese be golegar. Ar emide, mimmi-nikuo-itogedba, anba bur dummarba san-imaked. Emigindi, Bab-Jehová sogoed, wede doagi ataklegoe: Begine, igi angine.
Geb degine, Abram Sarai-abin sogded: —Be-itoleged, be-mai begi siid. Ar igi be Agar imakbie, be imakodo. Geb degine, Sarai sabsur Agar-imakalid. Degisoggu, a-ular, Agar wakitesunnad.
Ar Bab-Jehová-e-baliwitur nega-dulesulidganba, Shur-igar-maidsik dii-saila-siidgi Agar-abingualid.
Bab-e-baliwitur Agarʼse egichialid: —Sarai-e-mai-Agar, ¿bia be daniki? ¿Bia be nae? Agar abin-sogded: —An-dummad-Sarai-idu an wakinmai.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová-baliwitur ega sogded: —Be-dummadse gannar be nae. Ar igi bega sogdagoe, bela aba be ibmar imako.

content.text: Bab-Jehová be-wilediid itossoggu, we-machigwa Ismaelʼye be onugsaoed.

content: Ar Agarʼde Bab-Jehová-ebo sunmaksasoggu, Bab-Dummad an-dakmaidye neg onugsasad. Ar ade soged, Bab-Dummad-an-daksaye. Degite, amba an dula-gudiiye.
A-ulale, dia nugad, Dia-Dule-Dulad-An-Dakmaidye. We-diadega Cades, degi, Bered-ebo-abingunaid-abargi siid.
Geb degine, omegwa-Agar, Abramʼga machigwa baknonikid. Geb Abram, a-machigwa Ismaelʼye onug-imaksad.
Ismael gwalulenonigua, deunni, Abram birga-dulabake-gakanergwa (86) nikad.
